entities.summary: Azizbek Abdugofurov is an Uzbekistani professional boxer who held the WBC Silver super-middleweight title from 2018 to March 2021. As an amateur, Abdugofurov represented Uzbekistan at the 2013 AIBA World Boxing Championships.
